about: The viewer's fixed light presets (the studio's four are studio, daylight, sunset and night; overcast stays for the legacy scenes, and daylight comes last so the presets' positions, which moments and keys use, are unchanged) (an idea from Filament's gltf_viewer: a small fixed set of lights). The sun is elevation and azimuth in degrees; colours are linear RGB. `params` are any other registered params the preset sets (missing ones are skipped): the look's rim at its full strength and wider than its default (critic round 2: the 0.55 rim was not seen on any shadow side; 0.85 still read faintly) and no vignette (critic round 2: its bright middle read as a haze disc behind the subject), and the sky: day presets follow the sun, the night lamp puts the dome's sun under the horizon (a dark night sky, critic round 2: it showed a daylight sky) and a low exposure: the film preset's sky and ground fill is a fixed level (a shader constant: changing it rebuilds the model pipelines), so the night is darkened by exposure, which the glowing lamp shrugs off; and bloom: the night lowers its threshold and raises its strength so the lit shade blooms (critic round 2: the shade was a flat cream ellipse), the day presets put the look's own values back; and on every preset `fx.bloom.lit_floor` 1.2 keeps the threshold over what the sun alone gives a white face (evani-fx `bloom-emitters`; critic round 3: a sunlit sphere and the lamp in daylight bloomed), which leaves the night threshold as it is; the rim 0.85 wide and the film's back kick light at 0.6, the same on every preset so a preset switch rebuilds nothing (critic rounds 11 and 12: the shadow-side rim read only as a faint fringe); `look.stylizedpbr.rim_tint` 0.8 turns the rim to the sky's colour at the silhouette (critic round 3: the base-coloured rim still read as soft light on every shadow side); `fx.shadows.distance` 8 m fits the shadow map to the viewer's small stages (26 m left 1.3 cm texels: stair-stepped shadows on the shader ball's foot); the night key light comes from the right (azimuth 50): from azimuth 140 the lamp post's shadow ran straight at the lamp camera, so it lay on screen right under the post and read as the pole running on below its base (critic round 4), where now it falls sideways across the lawn.
stage_about: Plain stage surfaces the scenes draw with (floor, props, the lamp bulb). Added to the look only when the look lacks the name; each instance tints them, so the base is neutral white.
